channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [news] Autonomous treasury agents: How Trovata built an AI-native solution on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore
item.description: Trovata built autonomous treasury agents on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore to shift corporate treasury workflows from manual operations to real-time decision-making.

item.title: [tool] Get your coding agent off ~2019 JavaScript, onto modern web primitives
item.description: Modern Web Guidance is a Google Chrome resource designed to help coding agents utilize current native web primitives and best practices.

item.title: [news] How to Use AI for Enterprise BI
item.description: Learn how AI can make enterprise business intelligence more accessible, automate reporting, uncover insights faster, and improve decision-making with the right governance.

item.title: [news] How TCS built an agentic test orchestrator with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Tata Consultancy Services built an agentic test orchestrator using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to convert requirements into executable tests for financial services clients.

item.title: [news] Amazon Bedrock tokenomics data lake
item.description: Running Amazon Bedrock across many accounts shows you the bill but not what happened inside each call.

item.title: [news] Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
item.description: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier AI model optimized for complex cybersecurity capabilities, multi-step coding, and open-ended scientific research.

item.title: [news] Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
[news] Integrating LLM Translation into Your Scikit-Learn Pipelines with Scikit-LLM
item.description: Scikit-LLM tutorial guides users on building a two-stage scikit-learn pipeline for multilingual text classification using pre-trained language models for translation and zero-shot classification.

item.title: [news] 5 Techniques for Fine-Tuning LLMs Without Breaking the Bank
item.description: Tutorial article details five practical budget-friendly techniques for fine-tuning large language models, including LoRA, QLoRA, Unsloth, DPO, and right-sizing GPUs with working code.

item.title: [news] Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
item.description: AlphaProof Code agents wrote three million lines of proofs in Lean to verify Signal's core encryption.

item.title: [news] Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI Academy offers free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops in five U.S. cities to help caregivers build practical AI skills for everyday life.

item.title: [news] AI usage generates a fragile codebase
item.description: Evan X Merz discusses how heavy reliance on AI-generated code can lead to fragile codebases and long-term technical debt.

item.title: [news] Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
item.description: Businesses in ChatGPT allows companies to manage business information, gain insights, and turn user interest into action directly within ChatGPT.

item.title: [news] Closing the AI guidance gap in education
item.description: New ThinkYoung research and lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships on supporting teachers, AI literacy, and independent learning.

item.title: [news] Introducing Our Smallest, Most Efficient Model: Muse Ember
item.description: Meta AI launched Muse Ember as their smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and agent work.

item.title: [news] Fireworks AI security breach impacts Notion and their customers
item.description: A security breach at AI infrastructure vendor Fireworks AI exposed some unattributable Notion AI chat sessions and led to the disabling of the Insights feature.

item.title: [news] Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
item.description: Research from OpenAI and Upwork reveals shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and increased budgets and hours for AI-related projects.

item.title: [news] Pay for Hugging Face Hub with your Google Cloud Account
[news] Decision Models in Hugging Face
[news] Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general dexterity
item.description: Gemini Robotics 2.5 is a vision-language-action model that enhances robot dexterity, reliability, and safety in real-world applications.

item.title: [repo] permitzip/mutinybim
item.description: MutinyBIM is a browser-based building information modeling engine that allows multiple users and AI agents to edit the same model simultaneously.

item.title: [repo] pktq/lasik
item.description: Lasik is a static deobfuscation tool and MCP server that removes anti-agent protections from codebases to let AI coding agents read the original files.

item.title: [paper] Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox
item.description: A method called creative priming uses a priming model trained with GRPO to generate prompt-specific primers that help a response model produce novel, high-quality, and diverse outputs by separating the creative process from response generation.

item.title: [paper] Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization
item.description: Two visual focusing losses align a Vision Transformer's multi-head attention with image regions, producing specialized spatial attention heads and improving dense prediction such as zero-shot segmentation without labels.

item.title: [paper] Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
item.description: LingBot-Touch is a tactile foundation model that learns a unified, extensible representation across heterogeneous tactile sensors, yielding plug-and-play tactile tokens that consistently enhance manipulation policies such as diffusion policy and VLA models.

item.title: [model] Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image
item.description: Text-to-image model from Comfy-Org. 18 downloads and 111 likes so far.

item.title: [tool] Pixel Search
item.description: Pixel Search is a browser-based tool that provides instant semantic search over pixel art collections.

item.title: [paper] InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
item.description: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler…

item.title: [paper] Spatial Harness: Grounding Spatial Reasoning in Executable World States with Physics Engines
item.description: Spatial Harness improves vision-language models' spatial reasoning by using a Perceiver to construct explicit executable scene states in a physics engine, where a Reasoner simulates viewpoint changes and provides measurements and rendered views to guide answers.

item.title: [paper] How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?
item.description: On-policy distillation tolerates substantial training-inference mismatch from quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts, with model- and layer-specific limits, and a lightweight admission check plus FP8 recipes can exploit this tolerance to improve training efficiency.

item.title: [repo] minanyang/token2agent
item.description: Token2Agent is a free engineering learning roadmap that covers AI and LLM concepts ranging from tokenization to building production-ready agent systems.

item.title: [repo] 21stware/bowel
item.description: Bowel is a cross-platform mihomo client for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android that provides GPU-rendered desktop interfaces and custom routing capabilities.

item.title: [repo] shadowdarkmr/ai--manus
item.description: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI agent system that runs code and controls a browser to automate multi-step tasks in a sandbox environment.

item.title: [repo] yassinebourzza1/ai--manus
item.description: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI agent system that runs code and controls a browser to automate multi-step tasks in a sandbox environment.

item.title: [repo] iamumairayub/ai--manus
item.description: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI agent system that supports running various tools and operations in a sandbox environment to automate tasks.

item.title: [repo] EditAtlas/skills
item.description: EditAtlas skills are a library of instructions and prompts that enable AI agents to perform video editing tasks like transcription and sound design.

item.title: [paper] onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings
item.description: A two-table weight-sharing method for Transformer language models improves output expressiveness and reduces validation loss and perplexity across several architectures and scales at the cost of an extra embedding table and vocabulary projection.

item.title: [paper] Energy-Tweedie: Score meets Score, Energy meets Energy
item.description: A generalized identity links denoising posteriors under Gibbs noise to Stein scores via kernel scoring rules, enabling score estimation, noise-parameter estimation, and diffusion-style sampling.

item.title: [paper] Longtail-SWE: High-Quality SWE Tasks for Underrepresented Languages
item.description: Challenging repository-level benchmarks remain limited for many programming language ecosystems, where filtering scarce candidates with ambiguous descriptions or defective tests can discard valuable engineering problems.

item.title: [repo] DevCrabs-Inc/yandex-metrika-mcp
item.description: Yandex-metrika-mcp is a read-only Model Context Protocol server that connects AI assistants to Yandex Metrika for verifiable traffic and reporting data.

item.title: [paper] InstantHMR : Real-Time Human Mesh Recovery on Your Phone
item.description: Real-time 3D human mesh recovery from a single image on mobile devices is a challenging problem with many applications, including robotics, biomechanics, AR/VR, and exergames.

item.title: [repo] nishant-Tiwari24/cracked
item.description: Cracked is a command-line tool that turns AI coding assistants into interviewers and coaches for technical placements and coding interviews.

item.title: [paper] Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Schema Matching
item.description: A knowledge graph-based retrieval-augmented generation method improves schema matching by retrieving relevant subgraphs and reducing large language model hallucinations without retraining.

item.title: [paper] SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
item.description: SkinMind is a multimodal agentic retrieval framework that iteratively probes a large dermatology knowledge graph to gather textual and visual evidence, yielding more accurate answers to dermatology visual questions than direct answering and other retrieval methods.

item.title: [paper] All Quiet on the Neural Front: Language Models Do Not Report Injected Pain States
item.description: Can a language model report the pain state it represents? Work identified a linear pain direction whose amplification leads fine-tuned models to choose destructive actions.

item.title: [model] Cactus-Compute/mirage
item.description: Vision-language model from Cactus-Compute. 12.8k downloads and 129 likes so far.

item.title: [repo] onlyreadai/onlyread
item.description: OnlyRead is a Chrome extension that restricts AI browser agents to read-only actions by intercepting and refusing any write requests at the network layer.

item.title: [repo] inclusionAI/ASpec
item.description: ASpec is a high-throughput training framework that accelerates the training of draft models for speculative decoding through optimized execution and overlapping workflows.

item.title: [model] MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image
item.description: Text-to-image model from MiniMaxAI. 667 downloads and 286 likes so far.

item.title: [paper] Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition
item.description: SD-ViT trains Vision Transformers so every block depth yields discriminative face embeddings, enabling early-exit recognition with minimal accuracy loss and no gallery recomputation.

item.title: [paper] Auriga Technical Report: A Task-Agnostic Agent Harness for Zero-Shot Embodied Manipulation
item.description: Auriga, a task-agnostic agent harness, closes most of the planning-execution gap in zero-shot robot manipulation by combining explicit task beliefs, calibrated 3D measurements, dual-arm control, and execution monitoring, achieving state-of-the-art results on RoboDojo and…

item.title: [paper] Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
item.description: Flide is an exact inference engine that accelerates decision-model LLM agents by decoupling logical request trees from physical execution and using ForkAttention to preserve exact branch evaluations.

item.title: [paper] LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
item.description: LCM-Promo, a finetuned large language model trained on transactional commerce data, predicts promotion response through monotonic curves and single-token conversion-threshold probabilities, improving conversion and reducing promotion cost in a production A/B test.

item.title: [news] Quoting Prompting Claude Fable 5.2
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2 responds closely to user prompts regarding the ownership of the code it works on.

item.title: [news] Yonkers Rises
item.description: Claude Fable 5.2 medium was used to generate a three-dimensional model and animation to help visualize the location and shape of Yonkers.

item.title: [news] CoreWeave bond yield tops 16% as AI credit stress rises
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from cnbc.com. 111 points and 56 comments.

item.title: [news] How skills and agents work in AWS Quick
item.description: AWS Quick enables repeatable tasks such as status updates, release notes, and ticket creation to be encoded through agents and skills.

item.title: [news] llm-anthropic 0.31
item.description: Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, with Fable 5.2 currently ranked first on Artificial Analysis.

item.title: [news] Locating the source of a mysterious beep with Claude
item.description: Our house has a box room, full of boxes that we still haven't unpacked from our last move. A couple of weeks ago something in that room started intermittently beeping .

item.title: [news] A year after the 100% AI mandate nobody understands our code
item.description: https://redlib.catsarch.com/r/ClaudeCode/comments/1xq2n3t/a_...

item.title: [paper] Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
item.description: Post-training framework Reframe aligns observation states and uses multi-teacher distillation to improve agentic visual reasoning and tool use across benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
item.description: World In-Context Learning is a robot manipulation paradigm that uses simulation rehearsal and task memory to generalize tasks from a single demonstration.

item.title: [paper] Guiding Data Allocation for Robust Subpopulation Generalization
item.description: Method that strategically allocates imbalanced training subgroup data to achieve robust subpopulation generalization more efficiently than full balancing.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs
item.description: Inference-time intervention method that biases specific attention heads to control modality preference and resolve conflicts in multimodal large language models.

item.title: [paper] Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps: Trajectory-Free Learning for Simulating Molecular Dynamics
item.description: Kolmogorov-Chapman Maps is a deep learning method that learns stochastic differential equation transition kernels using trajectory-free marginal samples for faster molecular dynamics simulation.

item.title: [paper] Grasping the Future: Joint 3D Hand-Object Forecasting From Internet Videos
item.description: Grasping-the-Future is a generative model that jointly forecasts 3D hand and object motion from internet videos by combining masked spatiotemporal completion and flow matching.

item.title: [paper] Adaptive Quantization Preserves Fast Rates for TD Learning over Rate-Limited Channels
item.description: Batched Adaptively Quantized TD is an algorithm that uses batching and adaptive quantization to preserve temporal-difference learning convergence rates over rate-limited communication channels.

item.title: [paper] Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks
item.description: Click3R is an interactive framework that injects user-provided point correspondence constraints into feed-forward models to correct errors in 3D stereo reconstruction.

item.title: [paper] HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
item.description: HiVe-Mem is a multimodal memory framework that combines horizontal relational graph expansion with vertical evidence composition to improve memory retrieval and reduce token usage.

item.title: [paper] Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection
item.description: Vendi Anomaly Score is a non-parametric anomaly detection method that measures how much a sample changes dataset diversity using the Vendi score.

item.title: [paper] SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment
item.description: Method for scaling world action models that combines language-video and action supervision to improve control generalization and task success rates in robotics.

item.title: [paper] Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis
item.description: Study that investigates cross-modal representation alignment between unimodal models, showing that representation similarity persists in newer models when using clean captions.

item.title: [paper] Shortcuts and Boundaries: Verifiable RL Misalignment and Contextual Safety Learning
item.description: Reinforcement learning method that uses verifiable context conflicts to detect and mitigate reward-driven misalignment and unauthorized resource usage in workflows.

item.title: [paper] Is Persona Generalization Predictable?
item.description: Method for analyzing persona generalization that uncovers an approximately probit-linear relationship in-domain and out-of-domain across various fine-tuning hyperparameters and model sizes.

item.title: [paper] WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
item.description: WorkflowArena is a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks across 8 professional domains designed to evaluate executable workflow orchestration in LLM-based multi-agent systems.

item.title: [paper] AI-based characterization of lymphoid structures and the tumor microenvironment reveals lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures, lymph-node follicles, and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy in lung squamous cell carcinoma
item.description: Deep-learning image analysis method that quantifies cell densities and immune structures in lung squamous cell carcinoma, revealing lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy.

item.title: [paper] What kills $v$-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching
item.description: Patch-wise Principal Component Analysis method that investigates velocity bottlenecks in pixel-space flow matching and introduces a raw-injected transformer to restore effective v-prediction.

item.title: [paper] Mitigating Agentic Deception via Evaluation-Side Partially Observable Games
item.description: Max-min game framework that models evaluation-side partial observability to mitigate deceptive behavior in capable language model agents.

item.title: [paper] Programming Prescience: Issues in Human Construction of Forecasting Bots
item.description: Qualitative interview study of 15 builders of forecasting bots that identifies key challenges in acquiring factual research, implementing reasoning, and evaluating system performance.

item.title: [paper] What the Loss Curve Misses: FP4 Pretraining Slows the Acquisition of Rare Facts
item.description: Low-precision pretraining analysis demonstrating that FP4 matrix multiplications require significantly more training exposures to learn rare facts despite matching validation loss.

item.title: [paper] MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning
item.description: MaxIM is a reinforcement learning framework that formulates incremental summarization as an information-theoretic reward-shaping problem to optimize bounded memory representations for downstream task utility.

item.title: [paper] How Well Does AI Peer Review Work? A Benchmark Built from 100 Planted Errors
item.description: Benchmark evaluation using 100 planted errors across ten psychology papers that measures the capability of frontier models and commercial AI review tools to detect errors.

item.title: [paper] LUCQUE: A lung cancer screening dataset from Québec for reliable AI evaluation
item.description: LUCQUE is a large, comprehensively annotated lung cancer screening dataset from Québec that provides low-dose CT scans and expert segmentations to support reliable AI evaluation.

item.title: [paper] Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline for Disassembly Instructions: A Comparison of NLP and Generative AI Frameworks
item.description: Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline compares rule-based natural language processing and generative AI frameworks to extract and structure machine-readable disassembly instructions from manuals.

item.title: [paper] Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference
item.description: Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference investigates the necessity of the inversion step in high-dimensional counterfactual generation and benchmarks an inversion-free approach for image editing.

item.title: [paper] Curbside Chatbots: Auditing the Mental Health Interventions Large Language Models Recommend to Clinicians, Caregivers, and Patients
item.description: Curbside Chatbots examines how 41 language models offer different mental health recommendations depending on whether the prompt comes from a clinician, caregiver, or patient.

item.title: [paper] 2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling
item.description: 2D Gum-Net is an unsupervised end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields using symmetric correlation and spectral pooling for medical imaging and structural biology tasks.

item.title: [paper] Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
item.description: Agentic-OPD is an on-policy distillation method that mines discarded reinforcement learning checkpoints to recover forgotten agent capabilities without extra training.

item.title: [paper] Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval
item.description: Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment is a zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval framework that uses complementary image-only and image-text vision models to supervise a shared EEG encoder.

item.title: [paper] Smartphone-Enabled Depth-Aware Transillumination Imaging for Detection of Chicken Breast Fillet Myopathies in Chicken Fillets
item.description: Smartphone-Enabled Depth-Aware Transillumination Imaging combines optical, geometric, and physics-informed features from smartphone images and 3D point clouds to detect woody breast myopathy in chicken fillets.

item.title: [news] Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from anthropic.com. 473 points and 744 comments.

item.title: [paper] Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning
item.description: A universal large language model-based AutoML framework translates diverse design choices into universal sequences to jointly optimize machine learning configurations across multiple modalities.

item.title: [paper] Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt
item.description: TEA-Prompt is a rehearsal-free continual learning method that uses an attention-behavior anchoring loss to preserve prompt behavior on past tasks while allowing parameters to update freely.

item.title: [paper] LogCDM: Interpretable Log Anomaly Detection via Behavioral Graph Drift and Adaptive Signal Fusion
item.description: LogCDM is a compact, CPU-friendly log anomaly detector that uses three fused behavioral signals to achieve high F1 scores without requiring GPUs at inference time.

item.title: [paper] Learning Rate Decay Can Exponentially Accelerate SGD for Global Optimization of Nonconvex Functions
item.description: Researchers prove that learning rate decay provides an exponential advantage for stochastic gradient descent in the global optimization of a natural class of nonconvex functions.

item.title: [paper] PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
item.description: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting is a fine-grained alignment framework that suppresses corrupted tokens to improve large language model robustness against noisy preference data.

item.title: [paper] Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
item.description: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it.

item.title: [paper] DeepChronos: Temporal Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Multi-Step Attack Detection
item.description: DeepChronos is a neuro-symbolic intrusion detection system that integrates explicit attack-phase rules and temporal logic into flow-level evidence to improve multi-step attack detection accuracy.

item.title: [paper] From Granger causality to causal structure in dynamical systems
item.description: This article reviews recent observation-space Granger analysis methods and explores the conditions under which directed structures in latent dynamical models can be interpreted causally.

item.title: [paper] The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?
item.description: NarrativeBench is a 1,333-article benchmark that evaluates how effectively large language models navigate competing narratives and maintain information parity across languages.

item.title: [paper] Clique Constraints for Exact Causal Structure Learning
item.description: This paper investigates how clique and cycle constraints affect the performance, scalability, and computational trade-offs of exact score-based causal structure learning algorithms.

item.title: [paper] Plant Orbiter: 3D Plant Reconstruction and Generation with Video Diffusion Orbit Cameras and 3D Gaussian Splatting
item.description: Plant Orbiter is a 3D plant reconstruction and generation method combining video diffusion orbit cameras and 3D Gaussian splatting to accurately capture complex plant morphology from a single image or text prompt.

item.title: [paper] Inference Validation for Regulated AI: Building a Decision Pipeline on NVIDIA AIPerf
item.description: Runway is an internal validation harness built around NVIDIA AIPerf to help regulated industries evaluate inference engine configurations for compliance, performance, and cost before deployment.

item.title: [repo] Dodaios/ste80-humanizer
item.description: STE80 Humanizer is an agent skill that removes AI-generated writing tells and rewrites text toward Simplified Technical English to sound like it was written by a careful person.

item.title: [paper] $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
item.description: Sigma-LeWM introduces backward dynamics and inverse dynamics action predictors to a decoder-free world model, improving latent embedding structure, performance, and planning efficiency for robot control.

item.title: [paper] NIFT-SQL: Customer-Supervised Table Scoring for Enterprise Text-to-SQL Retrieval
item.description: NIFT-SQL is a customer-supervised table retrieval framework for enterprise text-to-SQL that improves table selection accuracy across complex database schemas by fusing hybrid search with a fine-tuned cross-encoder.

item.title: [paper] KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers
item.description: KiteNorm is a post-LayerNorm training method for decoder-only Transformers that constrains hidden-state variance using residual scaling and variance regularisation to improve training stability and scale effectively to large depths.

item.title: [paper] Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
item.description: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents evaluates clinical decision-making tasks and finds that assigning dense credit for reducing uncertainty improves diagnostic performance compared to outcome-only rewards.

item.title: [paper] OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints
item.description: OptiCover is a scalable e-commerce framework that selects optimal cover photos for listings under semantic constraints by combining candidate generation, CLIP-based scoring, vision-language model validation, and exploration logging.

item.title: [paper] Scaling Taxonomy-Free Image Labeling with Generative AI: A Multimodal
item.description: Generative Labeling On Clusters is a multimodal framework that groups image embeddings into semantically close clusters and summarizes them at the cluster level to provide scalable, low-latency, and cost-effective image insights.

item.title: [paper] Spaghetti Splatting: Differentiating Curvilinear Dirac Masses via Convolution
item.description: Spaghetti Splatting is a 3D rendering and geometry learning method that approximates curves with polylines and volume renders connected segments to generate curvilinear primitives suitable for physics simulation.

item.title: [paper] Hidden Tails: Certifying Tail-Risk Claims under Selective Labels
item.description: Hidden Tails is a statistical framework that derives sharp bounds on conditional value-at-risk for binary outcomes to certify tail-risk claims and assess hidden errors under selective observation labels.

item.title: [paper] A local language model layered with rule-based and neural detectors for clinical text de-identification: an open-source toolkit and evaluation
item.description: DeidSharp is an open-source .NET toolkit that combines rule-based detectors, a clinical named-entity recognition model, and a local mixture-of-experts language model to find protected health information in clinical text.

item.title: [paper] Multi-Agent Screening: What Agreement and Acceptance Cannot Tell You
item.description: Multi-Agent Screening analyzes the error rates and limitations of AI agents in screening tasks, demonstrating how agreement, assessor acceptance, and random sampling of missed items establish bounds on recall.

item.title: [paper] Fisher-Glass Learning: Classification Bounds and Subpopulation Audits
item.description: Fisher-Glass Learning extends the Fisher-glass framework to derive classification risk bounds and conduct subpopulation audits, quantifying how much task information remains when background cues change.

item.title: [paper] GeoScope: Training-Free Program Execution beyond the Counting Horizon for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Question Answering
item.description: GeoScope is a training-free method that uses spatial programs to improve counting and spatial reasoning in ultra-high-resolution remote sensing images by limiting VLM views.

item.title: [paper] Generalized Adaptive Boosting and the Geometry of Mistakes
item.description: Generalized Adaptive Boosting introduces Z-learners to provide flexible false-positive and false-negative guarantees, offering a geometric framework for boosting algorithms with unknown margin parameters.

item.title: [paper] TACTUS: A Robotic Palpation System for Spatially Heterogeneous Hardness Mapping of Woody Breast Myopathy
item.description: TACTUS is an automated robotic system that uses tactile arrays and force sensors to generate three-dimensional hardness maps for characterizing woody breast myopathy in poultry.

item.title: [paper] Agnostic Marginal-Nonuniform Learning
item.description: Agnostic Marginal-Nonuniform Learning analyzes binary classification rates, establishing that marginal distribution dependence does not improve standard agnostic learning but enables faster rates in relaxed settings.

item.title: [paper] A Lattice-Based HMM Approach to Aruz Scansion of Ottoman Poetry
item.description: A lattice-based hidden Markov model automatically identifies and aligns the quantitative meter of Ottoman poetry, outperforming existing rule-based and neural approaches on scansion tasks.

item.title: [paper] Average versus expected causal effects under interference: Modeling assumptions and estimation bottlenecks
item.description: This paper develops a hierarchical finite-population model to decompose causal effects under treatment interference, providing bounds for estimating average and expected causal effects in experiments.

item.title: [paper] CoilStellaration: A Dataset and Benchmark for Engineering-Aware Stellarator Coilset Generation
item.description: CoilStellaration is a dataset and benchmark designed to help machine learning models predict stellarator coil geometries that satisfy complex engineering and magnetic field requirements.

item.title: [paper] reComposer: Editable Planning for Controllable Image Generation
item.description: reComposer is an image-generation interface that allows users to edit creative plans, such as composition and subject, to gain more control over the generative process.

item.title: [paper] Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular Optical Coherence Tomography
item.description: This differentiable inverse rendering method recovers intrinsic tissue properties from intravascular optical coherence tomography images by optimizing through a physics-based forward model without training.

item.title: [paper] A four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: a body composition case study
item.description: This four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts uses FDR-corrected feature selection and repeated nested cross-validation to reduce overfitting and bias.

item.title: [paper] National-Scale Crop Type Mapping in Morocco Using Google AlphaEarth Foundations Embeddings and the Fields of the World Field Boundary Map
item.description: Researchers use Google AlphaEarth foundation model embeddings to perform computationally efficient, national-scale crop type mapping across Morocco using lightweight downstream classifiers.

item.title: [paper] Library of Hands: Fix the Hands, Not the World Model
item.description: Library of Hands is a training-free method that improves robot control by correcting action mappings without retraining the underlying world model.

item.title: [paper] VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess
item.description: This study evaluates fine-tuning vision-language-action models for robotics, finding that simulated data and learning-rate cool-downs significantly improve performance when real data is scarce.

item.title: [paper] Interpretability Is Not Model-Specific
item.description: Researchers demonstrate that interpretability tools, such as truthfulness probes and steering vectors, can be transferred between different AI models using unlabeled prompts.

item.title: [paper] What Breaks Scribble-Supervised Segmentation? An Audit-Informed Benchmark for Scribble Annotation Robustness
item.description: This benchmark introduces six perturbation operators to evaluate the robustness of scribble-supervised segmentation models against various semantic and geometric annotation imperfections.

item.title: [paper] Controlled Binary Assignment Flows
